description: Election Commission - N. Mahenthiran was elected as the member of the Chavakachcheri Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Chavakachcheri Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, and specifically declares a new member as elected. This falls under electoral processes and declarations related to local authorities, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7) as it deals with candidate nominations and declarations for a local government office.
